parameters.name: candidate_properties
parameters.description: Set of candidate commercial properties indexed by $p \in \mathcal{P}$

parameters.name: planning_horizon
parameters.description: Number of planning periods in the evaluation horizon

parameters.name: annual_income
parameters.description: Annual income generated by each property

parameters.name: incompatible_pairs
parameters.description: List of incompatible property pairs; each pair indicates two properties that cannot both be selected

variables.name: purchase_decision
variables.description: Binary decision indicating whether each property is purchased

constraints.name: binary_purchase_decision
constraints.description: purchase decision variable is binary for each property

constraints.name: budget_limit
constraints.description: total acquisition cost of selected properties must not exceed the available budget

constraints.name: incompatibility_pair_restriction
constraints.description: properties that appear together in any incompatible pair cannot both be selected

constraints.name: availability_limit
constraints.description: each property may only be selected if its availability permits it

objectives.name: annual_income_maximization
objectives.description: maximize the total annual income generated by the selected properties over the planning horizon

final_objective.description: maximize total annual income over the planning horizon by selecting properties, with income accrued for the full horizon length H
